chunks: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) [about] the saying of God, Majestic is His laudation: 'Those who listen intently to the Word, then follow the best of it' [39:18].
He said: It is the man who hears the hadith, then narrates it just as he heard it — he neither adds to it nor reduces from it.

key_terms.لا يزيد فيه ولا ينقص منه: Neither adds to it nor reduces from it — the classical standard for accurate hadith transmission
key_terms.يتبعون أحسنه: Following the best of it — interpreted as faithful, unaltered transmission of hadith
key_terms.يستمعون القول: Listening intently to the Word — in the Imam's interpretation, this means receiving hadith attentively

ai.seo_question: What does Quran 39:18 mean according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Abu Baseer asks Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) about the meaning of Quran 39:18, which describes those who 'listen to the Word and follow the best of it.' The Imam interprets this verse as referring to the faithful transmitter of hadith — one who narrates exactly what he heard without addition or omission. This interpretation reflects the early Islamic scholarly tradition's emphasis on precise transmission (dabt), where the most virtuous form of following divine guidance is to preserve the Prophet's and Imams' words without alteration.
